commits.message: fix(docs): a lone Esc in the readline stand-in no longer swallows the next key (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)
fix(docs): the readline stand-in ignores escape sequences, keeps keys past an Enter, joins a split CRLF and streams UTF-8; lint checks it (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)

docs: live and prompt pages run live, and NOT_YET_MIGRATED is gone (rich-docs-examples-xuu.byg)

The last two pages migrate: every live.md example is a bounded live demo, and
every prompt.md prompt runs live, answered by what the reader types. For that,
bundleExample resolves node:readline to docs/.vitepress/node-readline.ts, a
createInterface/question over the simulated terminal, so nodeAsk runs
unchanged in the browser.

With no page left to migrate, NOT_YET_MIGRATED is deleted along with its gate
branch and tests. live.md's "Redirecting stdout/stderr" section is removed:
LiveOptions has no such options.

Filed from the live output: rich-prompt-vo5e, rich-live-sadk.

docs: the text, styling and console pages show their examples' real output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.pt4) (#180)

* docs: the text, styling and console pages show their examples' real output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.pt4)

Eleven pages come off NOT_YET_MIGRATED: introduction, console, text, markup,
style, highlighting, contrast, transpose, template-bindings, protocol,
traceback. Every example runs at build time or carries its marker; no
hand-drawn output remains.

Folded in: rich-docs-gpe (stylize argument order), rich-docs-0dh (protocol.md
now documents Segment-yielding render with yield* delegation; the richConsole
hook, which nothing reads, is gone), rich-docs-drn (markup.md states which
bracketed runs are tags, with both surprises in the output).

markup.md's doubled-backslash paragraph is removed rather than rewritten to the
port's behaviour, which is bug rich-markup-nm1.

Filed from the real output: rich-color-dhay, rich-status-o9av,
rich-table-pyrl, rich-template-bindings-4bgw.
